evals.name: single-image-convert
evals.prompt: This hero image is way too heavy and slowing down my landing page. Can you optimize it for the web? It's at ./hero.png
evals.expected_output: hero.webp created next to hero.png, original PNG still present (not deleted), and the size savings (~70%+) reported back to the user.

assertions.check: hero.webp exists in the working dir

assertions.text: The original hero.png was kept, not deleted
The .webp is meaningfully smaller than the .png (>50% reduction)
The size savings were reported to the user
assertions.check: final message mentions a KB/MB size or a percentage reduction

evals.name: batch-folder-convert
evals.prompt: I've got a folder of client photos in ./photos that need to be shrunk down before we ship the site. Convert them all to webp please.
evals.expected_output: Every .png/.jpg in ./photos converted to .webp siblings, originals kept, a per-file and/or total savings summary reported.

assertions.text: All three images were converted to .webp
assertions.check: hero.webp, team-photo.webp, banner.webp all exist in photos/

assertions.text: Each .webp is smaller than its source
assertions.check: for each pair, webp size < source size
final message reports per-file or total size reduction

evals.name: web-project-with-refs
evals.prompt: My Vue site's images are killing my Lighthouse score. Optimize the images in public/img and update the code so nothing breaks. The images are referenced in src/App.vue.
evals.expected_output: public/img images converted to .webp; App.vue references updated from .png/.jpg to .webp with no broken references left; if sharp was installed it was removed with --no-save leaving package.json clean.

assertions.text: The images in public/img were converted to .webp
assertions.check: hero.webp, team.webp, banner.webp exist in public/img/

assertions.text: No stale .png/.jpg references remain in App.vue
assertions.check: grep for /img/*.png or /img/*.jpg in App.vue finds nothing

assertions.text: package.json was left clean (sharp not added as a dependency)
assertions.check: package.json has no sharp entry in dependencies/devDependencies
